title: Dad's Garlic Bread
description: A generous, layered garlic bread with olive oil, optional butter, three kinds of garlic, parsley, Italian seasoning, and Parmesan.
ingredients: 1 loaf Italian bread or French baguette (about 300–400 g)
15 g olive oil, or enough to drizzle lightly
1 g salt, or a light sprinkle
steps: Cut the bread in half lengthwise and place the halves cut side up on a baking sheet.
Drizzle the cut sides lightly with olive oil. Spread with the optional softened butter.
Sprinkle evenly with garlic powder, then spread the minced garlic over the bread. Add the dried roasted garlic.
Lightly season with salt and pepper, then add the parsley, Italian seasoning, and Parmesan.
Heat the oven to 350°F / 175°C. Bake the bread for about 8–10 minutes, until heated through.
Broil or toast for about 2–3 minutes until the top is golden, watching closely so the garlic does not burn. Slice and serve.
notes: Transcribed from Dad's handwritten notebook. The original lists one loaf, olive oil, optional butter, garlic powder, minced garlic, dried roasted garlic, parsley, salt, pepper, Italian seasoning, and Parmesan without quantities. All gram amounts above are suggested starting points, not measurements recorded in the original. The handwritten oven temperature is 350°F; its finish is about 2–3 minutes under the broiler.
